Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced a flawed sourcing heuristic that elevates any “primary” genealogical/birth-record snippet (and even suggests adopting a DuckDuckGo snippet claiming Bellevue, Ohio) over well-corroborated secondary sources (Wikipedia, IMDb, Find a Grave) that agree on New York City. This misclassification and overweighting could directly lead to selecting the wrong birthplace (Bellevue, Ohio) instead of the correct answer (New York).
